children: Dalmia Bharat Refractories on Tuesday divested more than an 11 per cent stake in RHI Magnesita India for Rs 826 crore through an open market transaction.
RHI Magnesita India is one of the leading suppliers of high-grade refractory products.

According to the block deal data available on the National Stock Exchange (NSE), Dalmia Bharat Refractories Ltd sold 2,29,41,224 shares, amounting to nearly an 11.11 per cent stake in RHI Magnesita India.
The shares were disposed of at an average price of Rs 360 apiece, taking the transaction value to Rs 825.88 crore.
Following the latest transaction, Dalmia Bharat Refractories' holding in RHI Magnesita India dropped to 1.43 per cent from 12.54 per cent.
Meanwhile, SBI Mutual Fund (MF) bought over 1.66 crore shares, or an 8.07 per cent stake, worth Rs 600 crore, emerging as the biggest buyer of RHI Magnesita India's scrip.
Bandhan MF, Nippon India MF and ChrysCapital's affiliate Clarus Capital 1 purchased 62.74 lakh shares at the same price.
Shares of RHI Magnesita India rose nearly 3 per cent to close at Rs 378.60 apiece on the NSE.

title: Dalmia Bharat Refractories sells 11.11% stake in RHI Magnesita India for ₹826 crore
